services.clientProvidesIntro: To begin registering your trucking company, the following information and documentation are required:

clientProvides.title: LLC
items: Articles of Incorporation / Articles of Organization.

clientProvides.title: Proof of business address
items: It must be a physical address, not a virtual address.
Proof is required, such as a utility bill.
The address must not be used by another trucking company for this same purpose.

clientProvides.title: Truck information
items: The type of truck the company will use.
The number of trucks the company will have.

clientProvides.title: Drivers
items: The number of drivers who will work for the company.

clientProvides.title: Type of operation
items: Provide at least 3 types of cargo or operations the company will perform.
Examples: construction materials, food, machinery, general products, etc.

clientProvides.title: Business email address
items: We recommend using an email address dedicated exclusively to the company.

clientProvides.title: Business phone number
items: It must be a phone number dedicated exclusively to the company.
Important: once the number is registered, it is common to begin receiving many calls related to services for trucking companies. For this reason, we recommend not using a personal phone number.
